verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of performance at scale or of item caps for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. The API's pagination, X-Total-Count header and rate-limit Retry-After guidance are developer building blocks, not documented scale or cap behavior. One anecdotal comment about the UI not feeling snappy for a five-person team says nothing about large-workspace performance or caps, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
